meaning: chicken feet in black bean sauce
usage: The word 豉汁鳳爪 refers to a dish made with chicken feet cooked in black bean sauce.
It is used as a noun, so you can say, 'I want to order 豉汁鳳爪,' to indicate the dish.
You can use 豉汁鳳爪 in sentences to talk about food, meals, or restaurant orders.
When describing dim sum, 豉汁鳳爪 is often mentioned among other classic steamed dishes.
In casual conversation, 豉汁鳳爪 can be referred to when discussing favorite dim sum items.
